content.short: Polymer creates a universal router connecting all chains.
content.description: Polymer connects blockchains and serves as the IBC Transport Hub, establishing the industry-standard transport layer across networks. Its modular IBC design enables chains such as Ethereum to integrate IBC transport and become interoperable across ecosystems in a decentralized manner. This approach focuses on delivering a common transport mechanism that supports cross-chain interoperability, enabling diverse ecosystems to participate in a decentralized, interconnected landscape.
content.meta: Polymer connects all blockchains as a universal router. Discover Polymer and other RaaS Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
